sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.0.37
- Added interactive Multi-Currency Exchange Rates & Price Matrix admin dashboard
- Added real-time Base Price FX simulator with presets (350K, 450K, 750K, 1.2M) and live converted matrix output
- Configured currency psychological rounding controls per pair (9_end, 90_end, 50_step, 500_step, none)
- Added interactive Multi-Zone Free Shipping Thresholds table with regional currency selector and target method IDs
- Implemented full sanitization and options persistence for exacoat_core_settings
